ankle_inner_right_1.brimAlongSupportReason: The support under the foot-block arm stands on the bed beside the heel chamfer (330 / 230 mm2 of first-layer support on Bambu / Elegoo). Both slicers brim that support too, so the brim reaches 9-12 mm from the part; the part's own brim (outline nearer the part than the support) reaches 2.7 mm on Bambu, trimmed by the nearby support, and 4.5 mm on Elegoo.

ankle_outer_right_1.allowanceReason: The gusset end face on the bed carries the real 12 x 1.1 mm recess of the stock bracket (community-66/64 notch beside the gusset hole); the outer half keeps part of it. Bambu Studio loops the 4 mm outer brim into it: 2.4 mm2 inside the convex outline on both outer halves, a strip bonded on three sides, cut it out with a blade. Orca puts support feet there instead. Same notch as the V1.22 bases (13.3 mm2 there). Not an opening filled with brim.
